column1: # The families of the class table (tools/gate_class.py reads it).
#   family   the registry's canonical name (tools/arch-registry.tsv column 1, the first name of a comma list) or a
#            declared non-arch group (flint: its kernels before its reader lands; gemma4a, gemma4v, minicpmv47, qwen38d)
#   rep      R (a representative family, run whole on a landing) or F (a fixture family, run on its own change and
#   tier     main (the real tier runs its gates daily and at a release: deepseek41, glm5next, qwen4exp) or other (the
#            fixture tier at its landing, the real tier once a month or on a user report). A family new in a release
#            (tools/gate_class.py new_families) runs the real tier daily and at that release whatever its tier.
#   globs    the family's own files, space-separated; `*` stays in a path segment, `**` crosses one. A glob may serve
#            several families (crates/gpu/src/arch/qwen3moe/** serves the seven families that read it)
#   rotation_days  the days a family's gates may go unrun before the rotation asks for them: 7 for main, 30 for other
#            (tools/gate_class.py TIER_DAYS; `gate_class.py check` holds the column to the tier)
#   fixture  yes (the family has a fixture file, tools/fixture-dirs.tsv) or no
